# About this manual

Steven Yi created Blue to compose with Csound by arranging SoundObjects in
time and simplifying repeated setup work. This Blue 3 edition adapts the
original community manual for the TypeScript/Electron application.

## Authors and contributors

The original manual's preface is by Steven Yi. Its credits name:

- Michael Bechard — Java development; author of the original PolyObjects concept chapter.
- Andrés Cabrera — documentation, tutorials, and ideas.
- Dave Seidel — Java development.
- Kevin Welsh — blueShare server and Java development.
- Menno Knevel — documentation, tutorials, and ideas.

This edition also credits Blue's ongoing contributors. The [Blue 2 source
edition](https://github.com/kunstmusik/blue-manual/tree/7a92066a2aa8f0370026ba9527c158643c2935a1) preserves the original preface, credits, and historical
instructions. The migration baseline is commit `7a92066a2aa8f0370026ba9527c158643c2935a1`;
the current manual is versioned with the Blue 3 application.
